props: Promotes the exchange of Ras-bound GDP by GTP. Probably by promoting Ras activation, regulates phosphorylation of MAP kinase MAPK3/ERK1 in response to EGF.
Acts as guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) for RAS proteins. Catalyzes the GDP-to-GTP exchange, resulting in an increase of the active GTP-bound form of HRAS.
